# Payment Failure Card

Matches the error card in `post/error.tsx`.

## Preview

<PaymentFailureCardDemo />

## Installation

<Installation name="payment-failure-card" />

## Usage

```tsx
import { PaymentFailureCard } from '@/components/lomi-ui/payment-failure-card';

<PaymentFailureCard
  organizationName="Keur Studio"
  organizationLogoUrl="/merchant-logo.webp"
  errorMessage="The provider timed out before confirming the payment."
  onRetry={() => window.location.reload()}
/>;
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| `organizationName` | `string` | Merchant name for the avatar fallback. |
| `organizationLogoUrl` | `string \| null` | Optional merchant logo URL. |
| `title` | `string` | Error heading. Defaults to `Payment failed`. |
| `description` | `string` | Supporting copy under the heading. |
| `errorMessage` | `string` | Optional detailed error shown in the red alert box. |
| `retryLabel` | `string` | Retry button label. Defaults to `Try again`. |
| `onRetry` | `() => void` | Retry action handler. |
